title: generateElements
responsibility: Installs canonical HTML and SVG atoms in app or game projects while retaining a configured shared library and the existing design system.

inputs.name: generateElements.input
inputs.description: Optional options object (defaults to {}): root is the project directory, falling back to process.cwd() only when it is undefined or null, and detectProjectKind(root) must return 'app' or 'game'. force is forwarded unchanged as the force option of writePlannedFiles, so an omitted value passes undefined and force has no effect when a shared library is configured.

outputs.name: generateElements
outputs.description: Resolves to a GenerateResult with kind 'elements' and exportsUpdated always false. When atomLibrary(root) is not 'src/components/atoms', it resolves with name 'existing shared native atom library' and writes [] without writing files; otherwise it resolves with name 'HTML and SVG atoms' and writes set to the writePlannedFiles result.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by fail('Elements require a Harness app project.') when detectProjectKind(root) returns a kind other than 'app' or 'game', before any atom file is planned or written.

errors.name: Element generation failure
errors.description: Rejections from detectProjectKind, ensureParents and writePlannedFiles, and exceptions from atomLibrary(root), atomicComponentFiles() or process.cwd() (called only when root is undefined or null), propagate unchanged. The implementation has no try/catch, so no success result is returned when one of them fails.
